architectureDecisions: D1 — Export AGENT_CHILD_INHERITED_ENV = Object.freeze(['PATH','HOME','USER','LOGNAME','SHELL','TMPDIR','TEMP','TMP','LANG','LC_ALL','LC_CTYPE','TERM','TERM_PROGRAM','COLORTERM','XDG_CONFIG_HOME','XDG_CACHE_HOME','XDG_DATA_HOME','XDG_RUNTIME_DIR','XDG_STATE_HOME','USERPROFILE','HOMEDRIVE','HOMEPATH','APPDATA','LOCALAPPDATA','PATHEXT','SYSTEMROOT','COMSPEC','WINDIR']) from process-runner.js and index.js. childEnvironment copies only those names from process.env when they are own properties with a string value.

D2 — childEnvironment(env, { tool } = {}) returns { ...inheritedAllowlist, ...authPassthrough(tool), ...overlay } where overlay is env or {}. authPassthrough copies the tool's frozen authEnvNames own-string values from process.env, skipping NODE_TEST_CONTEXT always. Delete NODE_TEST_CONTEXT from the result. Do not spread process.env. spawnBounded takes an optional tool and runAgentInvocation passes its tool; runProcess and version probes pass none, so they get no auth passthrough.

D3 — tool-adapters.js: every adapter carries a frozen authEnvNames string array. defineAgentTool validates it (array of strings, frozen; defaults to a frozen [] when absent) and preserves it. The delivered codex, kiro, agy and grok adapters declare []. No vendor auth names are added without verified vendor documentation; operators pass auth explicitly via the caller overlay or the bin --env flag.

D4 — Export binOverlayEnv(binProcessEnv, envFlags) from process-runner.js: picks FAKE_AGENT_* string entries from the bin process env, then applies parsed --env entries last. bin/exharness-agent.mjs run and smoke collect repeated --env KEY=VALUE flags (malformed entries are UsageError, exit 64) and pass binOverlayEnv(process.env, flags) as env to runSupervisedTask. probe, deliver and report paths are unchanged.
D5 — PATH and HOME stay on the allowlist so CLIs can resolve binaries and read homedir config. ExHarness still does not read ~/.codex or credentials.

D6 — Tests EN1–EN7 use runProcess(process.execPath, ['-e', dump]) and runAgentInvocation with defineAgentTool. Plant EXHARNESS_PLANTED_SECRET and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY on process.env. Assert absence unless passed in env overlay or declared in authEnvNames. Assert overlay FAKE_AGENT_SCENARIO present. EN6 additionally spawns the bin with FAKE_AGENT_SCENARIO and --env like the delivered AT4/GR3 tests and asserts the fake CLI observes them. Assert PATH/HOME present when parent has them. Restore planted keys in finally.

D7 — Living docs/living/system/agent-tools/state.md Trust boundary: child env is allowlisted plus declared per-tool auth passthrough plus caller overlay forwarded end-to-end through the bin; host secrets in process.env are not inherited; operator overlay still wins. No Blackboard ids.

D8 — Evidence: executed env-allowlist-probe-result.json (spread process.env, planted secrets inherited, PATH/HOME inherited, NODE_TEST_CONTEXT stripped, childEnvironment not exported) and plan-defect-probe-result.json (D2 drops FAKE_AGENT_SCENARIO/RECORD and representative auth with the supervisor default; bin passes no env; corrected rule forwards declared auth and bin overlay while dropping undeclared ambient secrets).
D9 — observation.js mergedEnv stays a full process.env scan for redaction only; it is not spawn env. Do not edit observation.js.
D10 — auditPaths against this plan rejects packages/core-harness/** and docs/blackboard/**.

S3 — Auth passthrough [EN5]: adapter authEnvNames declared names forwarded, undeclared ambient dropped, overlay wins.

S5 — Docs and scope [EN7]: Living trust-boundary paragraph; auditPaths rejects core-harness.
